# Algorithm trading system using a machine learning model generated by auto machine learning as a filter rule.

In this work, the performance of a algorithmic trading system or strategy, based on technical indicators, is improved by incorporating a classification model that allows to discriminate potential operations of the strategy between winners and losers. The characteristics used as input of the machine learning model are generated from technical indicators at the instant that an operation is opened, obtained by a market simulation with data in Open, High, Low format, Close in the currency of the eurodollar. For the search process of the appropriate classification model, two mechanisms based on automatic learning and evolutionary algorithms are proposed, using the Evaluation of a Tree-Based Pipeline Optimization Tool for Automation Data Science (TPOT) library and a proposal based on the Elist Non-dominated Sorting Sorting Model (NSGAII) and TPOT, where the multi-object search for the accuracy and the System Quality Number (SQN) showed a metric to evaluate the sample systems of the selected, the results of the selected, the results of the results of the results of the results of the results of the results of the results of the results of the results of the studies
